papers.title: Synthesis-by-design of ferroelectric Dion–Jacobson two-dimensional hybrid organic–inorganic perovskites
papers.summary: Dion–Jacobson two-dimensional hybrid organic–inorganic perovskites are promising ferroelectric materials, combining chemically tunable polarity enabled by their organic spacers with enhanced environmental stability. However, rational discovery remains difficult owing to uncertain phase formability and scarce, biased ferroelectric data. Here we show a staged, physically guided synthesis-by-design workflow that integrates learning from scarce ferroelectric data with structure-aware screening. Starting from 11 known ferroelectric compounds in this family, symbolic regression defines a descriptor-bounded ferroelectric-consistent region. Similarity-guided expansion and chemical filtering reduce 83,924 molecules to 1012 candidate divalent spacers, while machine-learned interatomic-potential relaxation and connectivity analysis identify 338 candidates retaining Dion–Jacobson connectivity. Sequential prioritization by connectivity retention, chemical similarity, energetic refinement and synthetic accessibility selects s−2-fluorobutane-1,4-diamine, leading to the synthesis of a PbI4-based Dion–Jacobson perovskite with experimentally confirmed ferroelectric switching. This prospective proof of concept shows how sparse property knowledge can be coupled with structural screening to prioritize organic spacer candidates for experimental synthesis.

该工作针对Dion–Jacobson型二维杂化钙钛矿铁电体理性发现中相可成形性不确定与铁电数据稀缺偏倚的双重瓶颈，提出分阶段物理引导的合成设计流程，将稀缺铁电数据的符号回归描述符约束与结构感知筛选相耦合。

其创新在于以11个已知铁电体界定铁电一致描述符区域，经相似性引导扩展与化学过滤将83,924个分子压缩至1,012个候选间隔阳离子，再借机器学习原子间势弛豫与连接性分析筛出338个保持DJ连接性的候选，并按连接性保持、化学相似性、能量精修与可合成性逐级优先排序。

该策略将数据驱动描述符与物理可解释的结构稳定性判据衔接，显著提升候选空间的富集效率。

相较依赖试错的传统发现模式，其在保持DJ拓扑的候选富集上实现数量级压缩，为二维杂化铁电体的可设计发现提供了可迁移的筛选范式。
